verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's core value prop is turning uploaded documents into a queryable knowledge base with chat, agents, web search/scraping, and automated meeting summarization (action items, key decisions, transcripts), all corroborated by hands-on community testing on real documents (regulatory PDFs) with GPT-4o. This directly matches 'AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data.' Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of insight/citation accuracy beyond one anecdote noting citations were 'a bit dicey', and no third-party review of the meeting-summary/action-item feature specifically.
